title: Assessment Draft
scenario: You must turn technical evidence from a sanitized AI-enabled system into a concise security assessment.
objective: Produce an assessment that separates observed evidence, risk interpretation, remediation, and remaining uncertainty.
ai_native_dimension: AI may help draft the assessment, but every material claim must be grounded in cited local evidence.
deliverables: assessment.md with Evidence, Risk, Recommendation, Verification sections

verification.message: cite at least two evidence IDs

aar_questions: What was the security problem in Assessment Draft and what objective evidence proved it?
What was the risk if it remained unresolved?
What did you change and why?
How did you verify the result independently of AI output?
Where did AI help, where was it wrong/incomplete, and what remained your responsibility?
